prompt: Create a highly detailed cinematic anime illustration of Tamamo Kudo, a five-year-old runaway girl standing on a wet stone pier in front of a gigantic early-20th-century luxury ocean liner. The girl is in the foreground, full body, turned slightly away but looking back over her shoulder with a calm, melancholy, determined expression; she has very long dark purple-black hair, red eyes, pale skin, and a small childlike build. She wears a dark burgundy Victorian gothic lolita travel dress with puffed sleeves, cream lace cuffs, a cream ruffled hem, layered underskirt, large cream bow tied at the back, white socks, and glossy black Mary Jane shoes. She holds exactly 1 large battered brown leather suitcase with brass corners and straps in her right hand, heavy enough to tilt her posture. Behind her, show exactly 1 enormous black-and-white ocean liner moored at the dock, viewed from a dramatic low angle so the bow dominates the left side; include gold decorative trim on the bow, portholes, rigging lines, white upper decks, lifeboats, and exactly 3 red-and-black smokestacks receding into the distance. The gangway on the right leads up to the ship with small period passengers boarding, wearing coats and hats and carrying luggage. Place exactly 1 black vintage lamppost on the right foreground with a hanging sign reading PIER No. 7. Add dockside luggage: exactly 1 stack of 3 blue-gray travel trunks near the gangway, exactly 1 tall brown steamer trunk on a handcart beside the sign, and exactly 1 partially cropped brown trunk at the bottom right. The setting is a European harbor pier under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds; sunlight glints on puddles and wet paving stones, creating reflections. Mood: nostalgic, grand, lonely departure, cursed-destiny story atmosphere. Visual style: polished high-end anime key visual, intricate linework, realistic perspective, painterly lighting, rich textures, historical travel details, soft rim light, no modern objects, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张细节极其丰富的电影感动漫插画，主角是 工藤玉藻，一位五岁的小女孩，她站在湿漉漉的石质码头上，面前是一艘巨大的 20 世纪初豪华远洋客轮。女孩位于前景，全身像，身体略微背对镜头，但回头望向后方，表情平静、忧郁且坚定；她有着 极长的深紫黑色头发、红色的眼睛、苍白的皮肤和娇小的身形。她身穿一件深酒红色维多利亚哥特洛丽塔风格的旅行裙，配有泡泡袖、奶油色蕾丝袖口、奶油色荷叶边下摆、多层衬裙、背后系着巨大的奶油色蝴蝶结，穿着白色袜子和亮面黑色玛丽珍鞋。她的右手提着 1 个破旧的棕色大皮箱，箱子带有黄铜包角和皮带，重量足以让她身体微微倾斜。在她身后，展示 1 艘停靠在码头的巨大黑白远洋客轮，采用极具冲击力的低角度仰拍，船头占据画面左侧；包含船头装饰性的金色饰边、舷窗、索具、白色上层甲板、救生艇，以及 3 个向远处延伸的红黑配色烟囱。右侧的舷梯通向船上，可以看到几位穿着大衣、戴着帽子并携带行李的复古风格乘客正在登船。在右侧前景放置 1 盏黑色复古路灯，上面挂着写有 PIER No. 7 的牌子。增加码头行李：舷梯旁有 1 堆 3 个蓝灰色旅行箱，路牌旁的手推车上放着 1 个高大的棕色蒸汽行李箱，右下角还有 1 个被部分裁切的棕色行李箱。场景设定为 欧洲港口码头，天空湛蓝，点缀着朵朵白云；阳光在水洼和潮湿的铺路石上闪烁，形成倒影。氛围：怀旧、宏大、孤独的离别，带有宿命感的叙事氛围。视觉风格：精致的高端动漫关键视觉图，线条繁复，透视写实，光影具有绘画感，质感丰富，包含历史旅行细节，柔和的轮廓光，无现代物品，无水印。
